description: This file defines a feature related to retrieving profile details within the application. It includes a query model, a validator for the query, and a handler to process the request using a profile reader.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object representing the query to fetch a profile by username, implementing IRequest for MediatR.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Username in the query is not empty using FluentValidation.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile query by invoking the profileReader to read the profile asynchronously.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the profile query request, returning a ProfileEnvelope by calling profileReader.ReadProfile.
